title: A non-merchant buy-down fee adjustment debits DEFERRED_INCOME_LIABILITY 22 30000 then credits FUND_SOURCE 5 30000 (loan 39 L1435)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the TWO-LEG journal entry a BUY_DOWN_FEE_ADJUSTMENT transaction posts on a NON-merchant buy-down product, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES_NON_MERCHANT_CHARGE_OFF_REASON, merchantBuyDownFee false) at the buy-down-fee-adjustment transaction L1435. request.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal.amount transcribes the loan read-back's buyDownFeeAdjustment transaction id 1435: amount 300.000000 -> "30000" minor units. request.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal.merchant is the read-back's top-level merchantBuyDownFee false, so the request leaves it unset (the zero value). request.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_PROGRESSIVE_ADVANCED_PAYMENT_ALLOCATION_BUYDOWN_FEES_NON_MERCHANT_CHARGE_OFF_REASON.json: fundSourceAccountId 5, deferredIncomeLiabilityAccountId 22, and NO buyDownExpenseAccountId (the non-merchant product carries none), so buy_down_expense is absent. The product's ONLY channel mapping is paymentTypeId 1 -> 17 and the adjustment was posted with paymentTypeId 5, which has no channel mapping, so the default FUND_SOURCE 5 applies -- exactly the account the observed credit names. expect.buy_down_fee_adjustment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the ORIGINAL two L1435 legs in id order from the journal-entries sweep: id 3007 entryType DEBIT glAccountId 22 amount 300.0 and id 3008 CREDIT glAccountId 5 amount 300.0. The read-back marks this adjustment manuallyReversed true and the sweep also carries its later reversal (ids 3013 CREDIT account 22 and 3014 DEBIT account 5); THIS VECTOR GRADES THE ORIGINAL POSTING, which is the posting createJournalEntriesForBuyDownFeeAdjustment itself made, not the reversal. The adjustment is the mirror of the buy-down fee: the Java local is named debitAccountType but is passed as the CREDITED account, and the helper's parameter order is (accountTypeToBeDebited, accountTypeToBeCredited), so the deferred-income-liability debit comes first and the product-selected credit account second. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: when the product's merchantBuyDownFee is NOT set the buy-down-fee-adjustment credit posts to the resolved fund source, not the buy-down expense account. THIS NON-MERCHANT OBSERVATION IS A TARGET of the ignore-merchant drive: a port that always credits the buy-down expense account posts account 23 here instead of 5. This product additionally carries a charge-off-reason-to-expense mapping, but the observed adjustment does not touch it. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the merchant buy-down-expense credit (sibling vectors). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
